posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Aside from the theme and the name, I don't see any way in which that game is like Resident Evil, which is one reason why your thread has been so confusing.
You can make a game like that in XP.
What I saw had nothing to do with weapons. You'd have a parallel event looking for button input, then it checks the spaces in front of the character to see if there's a zombie event to blow up.
So it all goes back to my first reply - hopefully you've spent time on the days since then doing tutorials and learning how to use your RPG Maker, because it's all just event commands.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
RPG Maker does not automatically generate games, the game in the video is just a TopView RPG with the term "Resident Evil" in the name.
You first need to learn how to use the engine and then create a game, try the functions, maps, create a basic game to understand.
